recent.text: Dusty May said the Mavericks are “still in our development phase” as he explained giving the reserves a chance to close in Utah. Dallas was up 18 when Cooper Flagg sat and up five when he and Kai returned. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/9EwBuXj61k

recent.text: Cooper Flagg said the Mavericks “gotta be smarter and take up some of the clock” late in games. Dallas took an early 3 on its first trip after going up 16 and later had a shot-clock violation. That’s one of six takeaways from Utah. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl:
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: The Mavericks led by 16 with 2:14 left in Utah. The Jazz tied it before Cooper Flagg made both free throws with 3.6 seconds left to give Dallas a 116-114 win. “We just got complacent,” Flagg said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/swTE8eWkHQ
